Windows one-file release of VBA Add-in Editor. The ZIP contains `VBAAddinEditor.exe` and its SHA-256 checksum file.

## A new look

The window has been redesigned around one dark "night" palette. Code is shown in Cascadia Code when it is installed (Consolas otherwise). The light theme is still under **View** and under the gear in the side rail.

- **Title bar:** the file name, whether Excel or PowerPoint is running, a search box (**Ctrl+K**), the number of unsaved changes and **Save**.
- **Side rail:** switches between **VBA code**, **Ribbon & XML** and **UserForms**, and opens **Find in Project** and the **Backups** list. The gear holds the theme, automatic backup and zoom.
- **Sidebars:** each list has a **Filter** box. Modules are grouped (Excel objects, Modules, Class modules, Forms) and marked **M** (edited), **A** (new), **R** (renamed) or with a lock (can't be renamed or deleted).
- **Above the code:** the module and the procedure the cursor is in. Click the procedure name to jump to any other procedure in the module.
- **In the margin:** green and amber bars mark lines you have added or changed since the file was opened.
- **Status bar:** cursor position, whether a backup is made on save (click to switch it) and the zoom level (click to reset).

## Search everything with Ctrl+K

**Ctrl+K** (or the search box in the title bar) opens one box for every menu command, module, XML part and procedure. Type to filter. Start with `>` to see only commands, or `@` to see only procedures.

## Ribbon structure beside the XML

When a ribbon XML part is open, a panel on the right shows its tabs, groups and controls. Click a control to jump to it in the XML, or use the arrows to move it up or down. Under the outline, the panel says how many callbacks are linked to macros and lists those that aren't, each with **Create stub**. The **Button**, **Menu** and **Icon** buttons add a button for a macro you pick, add a menu, or set a control's icon from a file.

## Review before saving

**Save** (and the "changes" button) now opens a **Review changes** window instead of a long message: the changed modules and XML parts on the left, a coloured diff on the right, a **Keep a backup of the current file** check box, **Revert all…**, **Cancel** and **Save**. **Revert all…** asks before discarding anything, and the file on disk is not touched.

A save that goes through cleanly shows a short notice in the bottom-right corner instead of a dialog. Saves with something to report, such as a backup warning or changes merged from Office, still show a dialog.

## Fixed

- After **Revert all**, the next review could still list the reverted changes. It doesn't any more.

## Notes

- This is a development build, built and tested on GitHub's Windows runner. It has not been through the full live Excel/PowerPoint qualification matrix. This release changes the window only, not how files are read or saved. Keep the automatic backup on.
- UserForm layouts are still shown as a read-only list of stored properties. The file doesn't store where each control sits, so there is no drawn preview.
- Known bug: a module whose code starts with a blank line fails save verification ("Body mismatch"). The original file is left untouched; remove the leading blank line and save again.
- Password-protected VBA projects remain read-only.
